signed_rows.behavior: Both install hints in apm/claude/.apm/hooks/hooks.json and in HOOK_COMMAND name the release, git+https://github.com/JasperHG90/kmctl@vVERSION, where VERSION is the package version in apm/apm.yml, and the hook still exits 0 when kmctl is missing.
signed_rows.fails_when: either hint lacks @v<the apm/apm.yml version>, hooks.json and hook_entry() differ, or the hook exits nonzero without kmctl

signed_rows.behavior: scripts/release.py set rewrites the ref in hooks.json to the new version.
signed_rows.fails_when: after release.py set to a new version, hooks.json still names the old ref

signed_rows.behavior: No installed rule, Claude or Antigravity, asks the user to edit it, and no Antigravity rule contains sync_antigravity_rules or a Generated by comment.
signed_rows.fails_when: any file under apm/*/.apm/instructions/ contains 'change them to where', 'sync_antigravity_rules' or 'Generated by'
signed_rows.command: uv run pytest tests/test_apm_package.py -q -k 'no_maintainer_comment or not_edited'

signed_rows.behavior: kmctl update writes a CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md block naming .agents/rules/ when Antigravity is installed, .claude/rules/ when Claude Code is, and all three folders with their tools when no harness is found.
signed_rows.fails_when: the block names a folder for a harness that is not installed while one is found, or omits an installed harness's folder, or names fewer than three folders when none is found

signed_rows.behavior: The briefing no longer names .claude/rules/ alone and stays within its 500-token budget.
signed_rows.fails_when: the briefing text contains '.claude/rules/ holds', or any test in tests/test_briefing.py fails

signed_rows.behavior: ADR 0020 and ADR 0011 carry dated corrections for the removed comment and the block line; the diagrams rule tells a repository with other folders to add its own rule under another name; docs/reference/commands.md matches the new block and briefing.
signed_rows.fails_when: a correction is missing, or the rule or docs still describe the old behaviour
